intro: AFF is where you stop being a passenger and start learning to fly.
headline: Every skydiver starts somewhere.
story: AFF is where you stop being a passenger and start learning to fly.

Over a series of progressive jumps, you'll learn the skills, awareness and control required to skydive independently, under the guidance of experienced instructors who have made thousands of jumps themselves.
Your first jump is the beginning. Each jump after that gives you more responsibility, more freedom and more confidence.
Until eventually, you're standing in the door by yourself.
And somewhere along the way, you stop being someone who went skydiving.
status: Registrations open now. Tell us you're keen and we'll send you the next course dates.

stages.title: Ground school
stages.body: A full day on the ground covering the aircraft, exits, body position, your parachute and emergency procedures.

stages.title: Levels 1 to 3
stages.body: Two instructors jump with you and hold on while you practise stable freefall and pull your own parachute.

stages.title: Levels 4 to 7
stages.body: One instructor flies with you as you learn turns, forward movement, flips and solo exits.

stages.title: Consolidation
stages.body: Solo jumps with a coach to build experience and canopy skills towards your licence.

licence.headline: The 'A' licence.
licence.tagline: The beginning of everything that comes after. Unlimited possibilities.
story: Not everyone wants to do one skydive.
Some people want to become a skydiver.
The DropX Licence pathway takes you from your first jump through to your A Licence, teaching you everything you need to become an independent sport skydiver.
You won't just experience the freefall. You'll learn how to control it, how to fly.
You won't just jump from an aircraft. You'll learn how to become part of the skydiving community.
There is a difference between doing a skydive and becoming a skydiver.
The 'A' Licence is your entry into the sport and career pathways.
Then you get to decide where you go from there.
